assumptions: Pacific is the Census Pacific division. The term resolved exactly to that division. Ranked airports are in Alaska, California, Hawaii, Oregon, and Washington.
Commercial airports are those at or above the catalog commercial enplanement floor. Airports below that floor are excluded.
Airports are ordered with higher observed freight pounds first. The rank uses that one metric. It is not the multi-factor investment screen.
The latest T12 window is {F5.period}, the trailing months ending at the latest month of T-100 coverage in this catalog.
limitations: Freight enplaned is the sum of freight on departing T-100 segments. It excludes mail. It is not deplaned freight, not cargo revenue, and not ton-miles.
Unmet demand, terminal capacity, cargo-facility capacity, fares, and profitability are not measured by this ranking.
Scores are relative to the airports in this set and change if airports are added or removed.
A shared displayed score among smaller airports is not an equal freight total. The only equal observed freight totals are CLD and CCR.
Airports under the commercial enplanement floor are not ranked, even if they enplane freight.
